messages: #b#p11##k's training is just about defeating monsters, but it seems really useful for learning how to hunt. Let's continue with #p11#'s training.

#b#p11##k believes that, while understanding my abilities is important, challenging myself with stronger monsters is also a great training method. She asked me to defeat #r1 #o9##k.
An #r#o9##k...? They seem really strong. Can I really defeat one?
After #b#p11##k's training, I feel much, much stronger. Time to get off Maple Island! I should go to #b#m60##k and take the boat to Victoria Island.
name: Mai's Final Training
